title: Charge Pump
text: Output a current proportional to the difference in duty cycle between two input ports, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Output current (A)} sets the design output current 1e-3, {Input threshold (V)} sets the logic switching threshold at input ports, {Enable increased buffer size}, {Buffer size} sets the number of samples of the input buffering available during, {Enable current impairments} adds current impairments to simulation, {Current imbalance (A)} sets the difference between full scale positive and negative current, {Leakage current (A)} sets the output current without any, {Enable timing impairments} adds timing impairments to simulation, {Output step size calculation} determines how output step size is calculated, {Maximum frequency of interest (Hz)} sets the maximum frequency of interest at output, {Rise/fall time (s)} sets the 20%-80% rise/fall time for up input port, {Up propagation delay} sets the total propagation delay for up input port, {Rise/fall time} sets the 20%-80% rise/fall time for down input port and {Down propagation delay} sets the total propagation delay for down input port. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output current (A)
params.values: Design output current 1e-3 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Input threshold (V)
params.values: Logic switching threshold at input ports 0.5 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Enable increased buffer size
params.values: Enable increased buffer size off (default) | on

params.name: Buffer size
params.values: Number of samples of the input buffering available during simulation 10 (default) | positive integer scalar

params.name: Enable current impairments
params.values: Add current impairments to simulation on (default) | off

params.name: Current imbalance (A)
params.values: Difference between full scale positive and negative current 1e-7 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Leakage current (A)
params.values: Output current without any input 1e-8 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Enable timing impairments
params.values: Add timing impairments to simulation on (default) | off

params.name: Output step size calculation
params.values: Determine how output step size is calculated Default (default) | Advanced

params.name: Maximum frequency of interest (Hz)
params.values: Maximum frequency of interest at output 10e9 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Rise/fall time (s)
params.values: 20%-80% rise/fall time for up input port 5e-9 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Up propagation delay
params.values: Total propagation delay for up input port 6e-9 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Rise/fall time
params.values: 20%-80% rise/fall time for down input port 2e-9 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Down propagation delay
params.values: Total propagation delay for down input port 4e-9 (default) | positive real scalar
